metadata.ffmpeg_version: 7.1-essentials_build-www.gyan.dev built with gcc 14.2.0 (Rev1, Built by MSYS2 project)

scan.note: Technical signals only. Continuous visual review and user approval remain separate.

sources.purpose: Shallow turn reveals jacket edge and trouser silhouette, then returns front.

replan: A01 originally rejected for duplicate turn; B02 instead stayed frontal. Reassign B02 as front shot and A01 as turn shot, avoiding another generation. B01 back-facing source excluded. A02 retained as frontal alternate only. This does not validate exact requested motion control.
editing: Tail holds shortened only; native source speed24fps, no crop/zoom/freeze/reverse/internal cuts/text/audio.

review.method: All192 film thumbnails,25 larger whole frames,5 face samples, all21 join/boundary samples and native turn/stance source frame36 viewed. No assistant continuous normal-speed watch claimed.
review.identity_clothing_background: Recognizable M05 and respective short jackets, tee, high waist, straight trousers, belt, bag and loafers in retained views. Window/wall/bench/floor remain broadly fixed; no obvious architectural drift observed in sampled/thumbnail views.
review.transition: 3.25-4.00s,18frames cross dissolve. Small head/foot position differences create transient double outlines and face ghosting; not an invisible outfit morph. No black-frame signal or size jump by crop/zoom. Comfort requires user normal-speed playback.
review.editorial: Charcoal/light gray front proportion then cream/cocoa shallow turn and return. Same short-jacket/high-waist/straight-leg theme. First shot quiet; viewer usefulness and magazine feeling remain unvalidated.
review.technical_limits: Only four diagnostic generations. Exact angle/pose control did not consistently follow prompts, so repeatable production is not established. Native tiny hand/shoe/bag details not certified on every frame.

user_feedback.user_quote: 這種類型剪輯不要了，跟之前大同小異
user_feedback.scope: Latest M05 E02 eight-second film and further minor variants of the same fixed full-person two-look dissolve display. Does not rescind historical accepted publishing files, the one-model/two-look contract, no-text rule or soft-transition preference.
user_feedback.reason: Insufficient perceptual difference from previous experiments.
user_feedback.next_gate: Before generating more media, compare the proposed whole-film experience with previous trials and an actually observed reference mechanism. A new name, different outfit or small pose change is insufficient.
